items.title_en: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
items.title_zh: GPT-6-Astra 是否已实现具身智能？
items.abstract_en: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedented performance (Fig. 1). Future research may focus on improving 1) the generality of ICL 2) cost and execution time, 3) physical-state verification, 4) recovery from irreversible failures, and 5) long-horizon preservation of progress. Second, we study the agentic harness for embodied control. We identify that close-loop coordination between a high-level "System 2" reasoner (i.e., GPT-6-Astra) and a low-level "System 1" controller (e.g., π0.5) is costly but effective. Third, we examine GPT-6-Astra on real-world deployment. Our experiments on 8 robot configurations reveal substantial gaps: 1) robot demonstrations required for ICL are expensive to collect, and 2) it is implausible to trade longer execution for higher success rates with physical constraints. Fourth, we envision the next generation of embodied benchmarks. We develop a prototype that 1) derives tasks from real-world needs, 2) provides no in-domain demonstrations, and 3) judges agents on a world clock that keeps running while they deliberate. Taken together, our results suggest that GPT-6-Astra has largely crossed the threshold of embodied competence, but not yet that of practical embodied intelligence.
items.abstract_zh: GPT-6-Astra 在机器人操作与导航上的表现，挑战了为单一任务和单一本体定制专用模型的传统范式。本报告在覆盖桌面操作、人形机器人、移动平台与灵巧手的 12 个代表性基准上进行大规模评测：在允许上下文学习（ICL）并大幅放宽执行步数的统一协议下，它取得了前所未有的性能。研究还发现，高层“System 2”推理器与低层“System 1”控制器的闭环协同代价高昂但有效；在 8 种真实机器人配置上的部署实验则暴露出明显差距：ICL 所需的机器人示范采集成本高，且受物理条件限制，难以用更长执行时间换取更高成功率。作者据此提出五项待改进方向，并构想以真实需求驱动、不提供域内示范、按持续运行的世界时钟评判的下一代具身基准原型。
items.highlight_zh: GPT-6-Astra 在 12 个具身基准上刷新性能，真实部署仍存明显差距
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：通用大模型能否直接充当机器人的“大脑”，取代为每个任务、每种机器人单独训练专用策略？
方法：作者以 GPT-6-Astra 为对象做了三类实验。①在 12 个代表性基准（桌面操作、人形、移动平台、灵巧手）上做大规模评测，采用统一协议，允许模型从训练集示范中做上下文学习（ICL），并把允许的执行步数大幅放宽；②把它当作高层“System 2”推理器，与低层“System 1”控制器（如 π0.5）组成闭环智能体框架；③在 8 种真实机器人配置上做部署测试。
结果：在宽松协议下，GPT-6-Astra 取得前所未有的表现，说明其通用操作与导航能力已跨越某个门槛。代价同样明显：闭环协同虽有效却昂贵；真机上 ICL 所需的机器人示范采集成本高，且受物理约束，无法靠“多花时间执行”换取更高成功率。
作者列出五个待改进方向：ICL 的泛化性、成本与执行时间、物理状态核验、不可逆失败后的恢复、长时程任务进度的保持。
为何重要：文中还提出下一代具身基准原型——任务取自真实需求、不提供域内示范、并用一个在智能体“思考”时仍持续走动的世界时钟来计时评分。这直指当前基准的软肋：允许无限思考时间与域内示范的评测，会高估机器人在真实世界中的可用性。

rm.usage: 一篇关于通用具身智能基准的评测报告，讨论 VLM 高层推理与底层控制的闭环，以及示范数据采集成本。对 RoboMaster 各具体任务（自瞄、导航、决策）没有可直接落地的算法，只能作为「大模型能否直接驱动机器人」的宏观参考，关联很弱。

items.title_en: Learning from Fleet Experience: A Collective Learning Paradigm for Robots
items.title_zh: 从机群经验中学习：一种机器人集体学习范式
items.abstract_en: Experience generated during deployment offers an opportunity for robots to improve policy reliability through learning from their own executions. However, learning through human corrections requires teleoperators to monitor execution and intervene when policies fail, a demand that is difficult to meet as robot fleets grow. We introduce collective experience learning (CEL), a learning paradigm in which deployed robots share their execution experience to improve a common policy. We realize CEL through failure-guided experience retrieval fine-tuning (FERT), which uses failure contexts from robot executions to retrieve relevant trajectory segments from the fleet's shared successful experience and uses their actions as supervision for policy updates, without collecting additional expert demonstrations or corrective actions. A fault-tolerant asynchronous training system (FATS) coordinates experience collection, policy optimization and policy distribution despite local interruptions within the robot fleet. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, the resulting policies achieve success rates of 93.3-99.2%, evaluated over 120 trials per task on robots excluded from training data collection. With collection time per robot held fixed, larger fleets provide more experience and FERT generally achieves higher success rates across the evaluated sizes. On multi-stage phone packaging, learning with 96 robots increases success from 79.2% to 98.3%. These results support collective experience as a practical basis for scalable robot learning and a path towards improving policy reliability during deployment without collecting additional expert corrective actions.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人在部署过程中产生的执行经验，为通过自我学习提升策略可靠性提供了机会。然而，依靠人类纠正来学习需要遥操作员持续监控并在策略失败时介入，随着机器人机群规模扩大，这一要求难以满足。我们提出集体经验学习（CEL）：已部署的机器人共享各自的执行经验，共同改进一个公共策略。我们通过失败引导的经验检索微调（FERT）实现 CEL——利用机器人执行中的失败上下文，从机群共享的成功经验中检索相关轨迹片段，并以其动作作为策略更新的监督信号，无需额外采集专家演示或纠正动作。容错异步训练系统（FATS）负责在机群出现局部中断时协调经验收集、策略优化与策略分发。在五项真实操作任务上，所得策略成功率达到 93.3%–99.2%，每项任务均在未参与训练数据采集的机器人上评估 120 次；在单台机器人采集时间固定的条件下，机群越大可提供越多经验，FERT 在所评估的各规模上通常取得更高成功率。在多阶段手机包装任务中，使用 96 台机器人学习可将成功率从 79.2% 提升至 98.3%。这些结果支持把集体经验作为可扩展机器人学习的实用基础，并为在部署期间无需额外专家纠正即可提升策略可靠性提供了路径。
items.highlight_zh: 机群经验互享加失败检索微调，免人工纠正即可持续提升可靠性
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：机器人部署之后如何越用越强？常见做法是人在旁边盯着，策略失败时遥操作纠正——但机群越大，这种人工监控越不可能。
2）用了什么方法：提出集体经验学习（CEL）。核心算法 FERT 的做法是：当某台机器人执行失败时，用它失败时刻的上下文（场景、状态）去全机群共享的“成功轨迹库”里检索相似片段，把这些成功片段的动作当作监督信号去微调公共策略。整个过程不需要新的专家演示，也不需要人给出“正确动作”。配套的 FATS 是一个容错异步训练系统，把经验收集、策略优化、策略下发三者解耦调度，个别机器人掉线或中断不影响整体训练。
3）有什么结果：在五个真实操作任务上成功率达 93.3%–99.2%，且评测用的机器人并未参与数据采集，说明确有泛化。把每台机器人的数据采集时间固定后，机群越大、经验越多，成功率总体越高；在多阶段手机包装任务中，96 台机器人把成功率从 79.2% 提到 98.3%。
4）为何重要：它把“机群规模”本身变成了学习资源，为部署期持续提升策略可靠性提供了一条不依赖人工纠正、可随规模扩展的路径。

rm.usage: 可借鉴其“失败上下文检索＋机群共享经验”的离线学习框架，把多台哨兵、英雄的实战与仿真日志汇总后做策略微调，提升决策可靠性；但RM机队规模小且强对抗，需自建失败样本库，只能算支撑性思路。

items.title_en: ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
items.title_zh: ScaleNav：面向语言条件局部导航的可扩展互联网视频预训练
items.abstract_en: We study language-conditioned local navigation, where a robot must navigate to a text-specified target visible in its initial observation and stop at the described location. End-to-end navigation policies require diverse training data to generalize across scenes, yet real-robot data is costly to collect and simulated data leaves a sim-to-real gap. Internet egocentric videos offer a scalable source of real-world navigation experience. Our key insight is to learn goal-directed visual dynamics from Internet egocentric videos, and use these dynamics to support robot action generation. To this end, we propose ScaleNav, a unified world-action framework with three-stage training. We first perform instruction-conditioned video pretraining on these videos to learn how observations evolve as the camera approaches instructed targets across diverse real-world scenes. Action alignment then uses action-labeled simulated data to train the model to predict executable action chunks. Joint fine-tuning subsequently optimizes all trainable components together for navigation. ScaleNav achieves success rates of 86.5% on a single-view adaptation of Short-Horizon OVON and 94.9% on our HabitatGS-LN benchmark, outperforming the evaluated baselines on both benchmarks. We further deploy and evaluate ScaleNav on a real quadruped robot, with results supporting the model's ability to generalize to real-world navigation. Code and videos are available at https://zju3dv.github.io/ScaleNav/
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究语言条件局部导航：机器人需前往初始观测中可见的、由文本指定的目标，并在所描述的位置停下。端到端导航策略需要多样化训练数据才能跨场景泛化，但真实机器人数据采集成本高，仿真数据又存在仿真到现实的差距。互联网第一人称视频提供了可扩展的真实世界导航经验来源。我们的关键洞见是从这些视频中学习目标导向的视觉动态，并用这些动态支持机器人动作生成。为此，我们提出 ScaleNav，一个统一的世界-动作框架，采用三阶段训练：首先在这些视频上进行指令条件视频预训练，学习相机接近指令目标时观测如何演化；随后用带动作标签的仿真数据进行动作对齐，训练模型预测可执行的动作块；最后联合微调所有可训练组件以完成导航。ScaleNav 在 Short-Horizon OVON 的单视角适配版本上成功率达 86.5%，在自建 HabitatGS-LN 基准上达 94.9%，在两个基准上均优于所评估的基线。我们还将其部署于真实四足机器人，结果支持模型可泛化到真实导航。
items.highlight_zh: 用互联网第一人称视频学目标导向视觉动态，再对齐成机器人动作
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：语言条件局部导航——机器人看一眼初始画面，按一句文字指令走到画面中那个目标并停在指定位置。端到端策略要在不同场景泛化就得有大量多样数据，但真机采数据贵、仿真数据又有仿真到现实的差距。
2）用了什么方法：把互联网第一人称（egocentric）视频当作数据源，因为里面天然包含“人朝着某个目标走过去”的真实过程，且规模巨大。提出 ScaleNav，一个“世界模型 + 动作”的统一框架，三阶段训练：① 在这些视频上做指令条件视频预训练，学“相机接近被指令目标时画面如何变化”；② 动作对齐，用带动作标签的仿真数据训练模型输出可执行的动作块，把学到的动态接到真实动作上；③ 联合微调，所有可训练部分一起为导航任务优化。
3）有什么结果：在 Short-Horizon OVON 的单视角适配版上成功率 86.5%，在自建 HabitatGS-LN 基准上 94.9%，两个基准上都优于所比基线；并在真实四足机器人上部署验证，结果显示能泛化到真实导航。
4）为何重要：它给出了一条务实路线——用海量免费互联网视频学“世界怎么变”，只用少量仿真数据学“动作怎么出”，从而同时缓解导航数据稀缺与仿真到现实差距两个瓶颈；代码与视频已公开。

rm.usage: 其“互联网视频预训练学习视觉动态＋仿真动作对齐”的三阶段流程可改用于哨兵局部导航：用赛场第一人称录像预训练、在仿真中对齐动作后部署；但方法强依赖语言指令，RM无语言输入，需去掉文本条件，改造量大。
rm.task: 哨兵机器人自主导航与决策

items.title_en: EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
items.title_zh: EgoXperience：从人类经验中学习世界锚定的第一人称表征
items.abstract_en: Reconstructing human activity from egocentric video requires more than recovering individual 3D components: the observer's motion, surrounding geometry, and hand-object interactions must fit together in a consistent world. Achieving this coherence requires both joint reconstruction and aligned supervision, yet existing methods and datasets offer limited support for either. We present EgoXperience, a full-stack paradigm that addresses these needs through data collection, automatic annotation, unified modeling, and benchmarking. Central to EgoXperience is an automatic annotation engine, EgoX-Engine, that couples geometrically verified object tracking with SLAM-based world alignment, yielding consistent supervision for the camera, scene, hands, and objects. This yields EgoX-Data-6M, a 50-hour dataset of task-driven manipulation and locomotion within and across indoor and outdoor environments, with second-level task captions. We carefully select one hour across these activity categories as EgoX-Bench to evaluate joint reconstruction. To translate this supervision into reconstruction, we introduce EgoX, trained with EgoX-Data-6M and complementary annotations from additional public datasets. Given monocular egocentric video and first-frame object masks, our model achieves joint metric reconstruction of the camera, scene, hands, and objects in a shared world coordinate frame with a single forward pass. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across scene estimation and world-space hand-object pose recovery. Against the strongest evaluated baselines, EgoX reduces camera, hand, and depth errors by 68.9%, 65.6%, and 42.9%, and improves object pose scores by 28.0%.
items.abstract_zh: 从第一人称视频重建人类活动，不能只恢复各个三维成分：观察者的运动、周围几何以及手-物交互必须彼此吻合于同一个世界之中。实现这种一致性既需要联合重建，也需要对齐的监督，而现有方法与数据集对两者的支持都有限。我们提出 EgoXperience，一个覆盖数据采集、自动标注、统一建模与基准评测的全栈范式。其核心是自动标注引擎 EgoX-Engine，它将几何验证的物体跟踪与基于 SLAM 的世界对齐相结合，为相机、场景、手和物体产出一致的监督信号，由此构建 EgoX-Data-6M：约 50 小时、覆盖室内外环境内与跨环境的任务驱动操作与移动数据，并带秒级任务描述。我们在这些活动类别中选取 1 小时构成 EgoX-Bench 以评测联合重建。为把监督转化为重建能力，我们提出 EgoX 模型，使用 EgoX-Data-6M 及其他公开数据集的补充标注训练。给定单目第一人称视频与首帧物体掩码，模型仅用一次前向即可在共享世界坐标系中联合度量重建相机、场景、手与物体。大量实验表明其在场景估计与世界坐标系下的手-物位姿恢复上达到最先进水平：相较最强基线，相机、手与深度误差分别降低 68.9%、65.6% 与 42.9%，物体位姿分数提升 28.0%。
items.highlight_zh: 自动标注让相机、场景、手与物体在同一世界坐标系中联合重建
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：要从第一人称视频理解“人在做什么”，单独估计相机轨迹、场景几何、手的姿态、物体位置都不够——它们必须放进同一个世界坐标系里彼此自洽：人走到哪、周围是什么样、手怎么抓物体。难在两处：既要有联合重建的模型，也要有天然对齐的标注数据，而现有方法与数据集两头都不足。
2）用了什么方法：提出 EgoXperience 全栈范式，串起数据采集、自动标注、统一建模与基准评测。核心是自动标注引擎 EgoX-Engine，它把“几何验证的物体跟踪”与“基于 SLAM 的世界对齐”耦合，一次性为相机、场景、手、物体产出彼此一致的监督。由此构建 50 小时、室内外的任务驱动操作与移动数据集 EgoX-Data-6M，附秒级任务描述，并从中抽取 1 小时作为 EgoX-Bench。模型 EgoX 只需单目视频加首帧物体掩码，一次前向即在共同世界坐标系中给出各要素的度量重建。
3）有什么结果：相对最强基线，相机误差降低 68.9%、手部误差降低 65.6%、深度误差降低 42.9%，物体位姿分数提升 28.0%，在场景估计与世界坐标系下的手-物位姿恢复上达到最优。
4）为何重要：它把“标注是否彼此一致”当成首要问题，用自动标注把数据规模做起来，为具身智能、AR/VR 等需要世界级人类活动理解的方向提供数据与模型基座。

rm.usage: 工程机器人装配时可参考其把相机、手（机械臂）、物体位姿联合恢复到统一SLAM世界系的思路，用于能量单元与机械臂相对位姿估计；但数据来自人类第一人称，需自采装配数据重训才有用。

items.title_en: Holi-World: Building Holistic World Intelligence from Human-Ego Experience
items.title_zh: Holi-World：从人类第一人称经验构建整体世界智能
items.abstract_en: Human egocentric experience offers a rich foundation for learning how the world is organized and how it changes through interaction. Realizing this potential at scale requires turning growing volumes of recordings into learning resources that connect scene structure, object semantics, and interaction histories across viewpoints and time, while reducing dependence on costly manual annotation. We introduce HOLI-WORLD, an integrated ecosystem connecting experience capture, world representation, automated data construction, model learning, and independent evaluation. To sup- port learning at scale, HOLIWORLD-Foundry combines complementary static and dynamic perception to automatically construct world records that connect persistent scene structure and evolving object states with interaction histories and supporting observations. HOLIWORLD-Data organizes these records from approximately 100 self-collected scenes into grounded learning resources, including approximately 80K QA pairs used to train HOLIWORLD-VL-4B. Independent human annotations of heldout recordings form HOLIWORLD-Bench, supporting evaluation of both annotation quality and learned spatial and temporal understanding. Experiments on ScanNet, ScanNet++, Aria Digital Twin, and HOLIWORLD-Bench demonstrate strong performance in static perception and dynamic tracking, while training on HOLIWORLD-Data substantially improves HOLIWORLD-VL-4B's spatial and temporal reasoning on HOLI- WORLD-Bench and EgoDynamic4D. HOLIWORLD provides a practical foundation for expanding learning resources from the continuous flow of human experience and advancing machine understanding of the dynamic world.
items.abstract_zh: 人类第一人称经验为学习世界如何组织、又如何通过交互而演变提供了丰富基础。要规模化释放这一潜力，需要把不断增长的录制数据转化为学习资源，跨视角与跨时间地连接场景结构、物体语义与交互历史，同时减少对昂贵人工标注的依赖。我们提出 HOLI-WORLD，一个连接经验采集、世界表示、自动数据构建、模型学习与独立评测的一体化生态。为支持规模化学习，HOLI-WORLD-Foundry 结合互补的静态与动态感知，自动构建世界记录，把持久的场景结构与不断演化的物体状态同交互历史及支撑观测关联起来。HOLI-WORLD-Data 将约 100 个自采集场景的这些记录组织为有定位的学习资源，其中约 8 万条问答对用于训练 HOLI-WORLD-VL-4B。对留出录像的独立人工标注构成 HOLI-WORLD-Bench，可同时评估标注质量与模型学到的时空理解。在 ScanNet、ScanNet++、Aria Digital Twin 与 HOLI-WORLD-Bench 上的实验表明，其在静态感知与动态跟踪上表现强劲；而用 HOLI-WORLD-Data 训练显著提升了 HOLI-WORLD-VL-4B 在 HOLI-WORLD-Bench 与 EgoDynamic4D 上的空间与时间推理能力。HOLI-WORLD 为从持续流动的人类经验中扩展学习资源、推进机器对动态世界的理解提供了实用基础。
items.highlight_zh: 约100个自采场景的录像自动转成8万问答对，用于训练世界理解模型
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：人类第一人称录像记录了世界如何组织、交互如何改变它，是训练“世界理解”模型的好素材。难点是把海量录像变成可学习资源：要跨视角、跨时间把场景结构、物体语义和交互历史串起来，又不能全靠昂贵的人工标注。
2）用了什么方法：提出 HOLI-WORLD 生态，把采集、世界表示、自动数据构建、模型训练与独立评测打通。其中 Foundry 模块结合静态感知（场景几何结构）与动态感知（物体状态变化），自动生成“世界记录”，把持久的场景结构、演变中的物体状态与交互历史、支撑观测关联起来。Data 模块把这些记录整理成带定位信息的学习资源，覆盖约 100 个自采场景，其中约 8 万条问答对用于训练 4B 参数的多模态模型 HOLI-WORLD-VL-4B。Bench 模块则对留出录像做独立人工标注，既检验自动标注的质量，也检验模型学到的空间与时间理解。
3）有什么结果：在 ScanNet、ScanNet++、Aria Digital Twin 等数据集上，静态感知与动态跟踪表现强劲；用 HOLI-WORLD-Data 训练后，HOLI-WORLD-VL-4B 在 HOLI-WORLD-Bench 和 EgoDynamic4D 上的时空推理显著提升。
4）为何重要：它提供了一条可扩展流水线——从持续产生的人类经验流中自动生产学习资源，并配有独立评测，使机器对动态世界的理解能随数据增长而持续进步。

items.title_en: Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips
items.title_zh: Fréchet Forcing：用短片段训练长时程流式世界模型
items.abstract_en: Streaming video world models generate the future chunk by chunk, conditioned on their own past and a stream of actions. Trained on short clips, they drift once a rollout exceeds the training horizon, as prediction errors re-enter the context and compound. A common remedy is to train the model on its own rollouts via distribution matching distillation (DMD). For action-conditioned world models, the teacher becomes a bottleneck: an external video model is agnostic to the actions, whereas the model's own pretrained network drifts in the same manner as the student. We observe that a long rollout need not match a teacher, provided it remains a realistic continuation of its own scene that follows the commanded actions. Realism and scene fidelity can be measured against real-data statistics, which remain valid at any horizon, while action following is preserved by the model's conditional generation loss. We propose Fréchet Forcing, which fine-tunes a world model together with its deployed multi-step sampler under three constraints. Generative anchoring applies the flow-matching loss after a self-generated history ending on real data. Context fidelity, a Fréchet distance (FD) on latent statistics of the free rollout centred on each clip's own ground truth, keeps every rollout faithful to its scene. Reality matching, an FD to real frames in a frozen perceptual space, keeps the generated frames realistic. Because all three targets are derived from short real clips without comparing a rollout against a long recorded future, training requires no teacher, no online critic and no long videos. Fine-tuning MiniWorld-1B, pretrained on 253-frame clips, for at most 36 GPU-hours on 381-frame clips yields rollouts that remain stable beyond 4,000 frames and continue to follow their actions in both robot manipulation and camera-controlled exploration.
items.abstract_zh: 流式视频世界模型逐块生成未来，并以自身历史与动作流为条件。仅在短片段上训练时，一旦推演长度超过训练时域，预测误差会重新进入上下文并不断累积，导致画面漂移。常见的补救办法是用分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）让模型在自己的推演结果上训练，但对动作条件世界模型而言，教师模型会成为瓶颈：外部视频模型对动作无感知，而模型自身预训练网络又与学生以同样方式漂移。作者观察到，长程推演不必匹配某个教师，只要它仍是自身场景的合理延续、并遵循给定动作即可。真实感与场景保真度可用在任何时域都有效的真实数据统计量来度量，动作遵循性则由模型的条件生成损失保持。为此提出 Fréchet Forcing，在三条约束下联合微调世界模型与其部署用的多步采样器：生成锚定（在结束于真实数据的自生成历史上施加 flow-matching 损失）、上下文保真（以每段片段自身真值为中心的自由推演潜变量统计量的 Fréchet 距离）、现实匹配（在冻结感知空间中与真实帧的 Fréchet 距离）。三个目标均由短真实片段导出，无需教师、在线判别器或长视频。将预训练于 253 帧片段的 MiniWorld-1B 在 381 帧片段上微调不超过 36 GPU 小时，推演可稳定超过 4000 帧并持续遵循动作。
items.highlight_zh: 无需教师模型，短片段微调即可稳定推演超 4000 帧。
items.digest_zh:
要点一：论文要解决的问题。流式视频世界模型是一类“边看边预测未来”的模型，它根据自己已生成的过去画面和给定动作，一块一块地生成后续视频。麻烦在于：训练时只能喂给它几百帧的短视频，可一旦让它连续推演远超训练长度，先前生成的画面会被当作“事实”重新输入，错误不断累积、放大，画面很快崩坏漂移。

要点二：现有做法为何不够。常用方案是分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），请一个“教师”模型来纠正学生的推演。但世界模型是动作条件的：外部视频模型不懂动作指令，而模型自身的预训练网络又和学生一样会漂移，于是教师成了瓶颈。

要点三：作者的关键洞察。长程推演其实不必与某个教师对齐，只要满足两件事：它是自身场景的合理延续（不换场景、不崩坏），并且遵循下达的动作指令。真实感与场景保真度可以用真实数据的统计量来衡量——这类统计量在任何推演长度下都成立；动作遵循性则靠模型原有的条件生成损失来维持。

要点四：方法。Fréchet Forcing 在三条约束下联合微调世界模型和实际部署时用的多步采样器：生成锚定，在“自生成历史 + 结尾接真实数据”的序列上施加 flow-matching 损失；上下文保真，用自由推演的潜变量统计量与各片段自身真值之间的 Fréchet 距离（FD）约束场景不跑偏；现实匹配，在冻结的感知特征空间中用 FD 约束生成帧的真实感。三个目标全部从短的真实片段中导出，不需要教师模型、不需要在线判别器，也不需要长视频。

要点五：结果与意义。作者把在 253 帧片段上预训练的 MiniWorld-1B 放到 381 帧片段上微调，最多只花 36 GPU 小时，得到的模型推演超过 4000 帧仍保持稳定，并且持续遵循动作指令。这意味着长时程世界模型的后训练可以变得廉价、可复现，不必依赖超长视频数据或额外的教师模型。

rm.usage: 可作为仿真侧的远期探索：用流式世界模型替代或加速长时程渲染，为强化学习生成训练画面；但RM仿真以物理引擎为主，长程生成漂移对精度敏感的自瞄无益，实用度低。

items.title_en: PnP-Transformer: A Neural Pose Solver for 6D Object Pose Estimation
items.title_zh: PnP-Transformer：面向 6D 物体位姿估计的神经位姿求解器
items.abstract_en: We present PnP-Transformer, a neural pose solver designed as an iterative-free, differentiable alternative to classical PnP-RANSAC algorithms. PnP-Transformer regresses the 6D object pose by processing predicted semi-dense 2D-3D correspondence fields alongside confidence scores, while mapping geometric inputs into a continuous latent space. To evaluate its practical utility, we integrate PnP-Transformer into a zero-shot 6D pose estimation pipeline, where the correspondence module and pose solver are trained separately. PnP-Transformer achieves a 41.2% mean AR score with low latency (0.46 s/obj) on seven core BOP benchmark datasets, surpassing all prior baselines (such as RayPose with 39.1% AR) but one (Co-op with 58.4% AR). When the pose solver is replaced with EPnP-RANSAC (similar to Co-op) while keeping the correspondence module unchanged, the RANSAC alternative outperforms PnP-Transformer on six of the seven datasets by reaching 52.2% mean AR at a cost of an additional 60 ms per object, revealing an accuracy-latency trade-off. Code and pretrained models are available: https://github.com/ebylmz/pnp-transformer
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 PnP-Transformer，一种神经位姿求解器，可作为经典 PnP-RANSAC 算法的免迭代、可微替代方案。它处理预测得到的半稠密 2D-3D 对应场及置信度分数，并把几何输入映射到连续潜空间，从而回归 6D 物体位姿。为评估其实用性，作者将其集成到一个零样本 6D 位姿估计流程中，其中对应模块与位姿求解器分别训练。在七个核心 BOP 基准数据集上，PnP-Transformer 取得 41.2% 的平均 AR 分数，延迟较低（0.46 秒/物体），超过除 Co-op（58.4% AR）之外的所有已有基线（如 RayPose 的 39.1% AR）。若在保持对应模块不变的前提下把位姿求解器换成 EPnP-RANSAC（与 Co-op 类似），RANSAC 方案在七个数据集中的六个上优于 PnP-Transformer，平均 AR 达 52.2%，代价是每个物体多花约 60 毫秒，揭示出精度与延迟之间的权衡。代码与预训练模型已开源。
items.highlight_zh: 免迭代可微神经位姿求解器，速度快但精度仍不及 RANSAC。
items.digest_zh:
要点一：研究什么问题。6D 物体位姿估计要回答“这个物体在相机坐标里朝哪、在哪”，是机器人抓取、增强现实等任务的基础。典型流程分两步：先找出图像 2D 点与物体模型 3D 点的对应关系，再用 PnP（透视 n 点）算法从对应中解出位姿。经典求解器 PnP-RANSAC 依赖随机采样与迭代，速度受限于迭代次数，且不可微，难以与上游网络端到端联合优化。

要点二：用了什么方法。作者提出 PnP-Transformer，用一个 Transformer 网络直接回归 6D 位姿：输入是预测出的半稠密 2D-3D 对应场及其置信度分数，网络把几何输入映射到连续潜空间后输出位姿标签（类别、平移、旋转）。它不迭代、可微、一次前向即可出结果。作者把它接入一个零样本 6D 位姿估计流程，对应模块与位姿求解器分开训练，以检验其作为“即插即用”组件的实用价值。

要点三：结果如何。在七个核心 BOP 基准数据集上，PnP-Transformer 取得 41.2% 的平均 AR，单物体耗时约 0.46 秒，优于 RayPose（39.1% AR）等此前方法，但明显低于 Co-op（58.4% AR）。为公平比较，作者保持对应模块不变、仅把求解器换回类似 Co-op 的 EPnP-RANSAC：结果 RANSAC 在七个数据集中的六个上更好，平均 AR 达 52.2%，代价是每个物体多约 60 毫秒。

要点四：为何重要。论文给出了一个诚实的结论：神经位姿求解器在速度上有优势、且天然可微，但在精度上尚未全面超越经典 RANSAC。它把“精度—延迟”的权衡摆到明面上，为后续设计端到端可训练、同时不牺牲精度的位姿求解器提供了可复现的基线与开源代码。

rm.usage: 可作为自瞄/工程装配中EPnP-RANSAC的替代或初值：直接由半稠密2D-3D对应回归装甲板或能量单元等已知模型的6D位姿，且可微、免迭代，便于端到端训练；但论文显示精度略逊于RANSAC，需按场景实测取舍。

items.title_en: Bio-inspired Thrust-Assisted Trotting on a legged-Aerial Robot via Real-Time QP-MPC
items.title_zh: 基于实时QP-MPC的腿足-空中机器人仿生推力辅助小跑
items.abstract_en: This paper presents the hardware implementation of a quadratic program-based controller on Harpy: thruster-assisted bipedal robot to perform thruster-assisted trotting. This is inspired by wing-assisted locomotion observed in birds such as the chukar partridge, which employ thrust vectoring to manipulate the ground reaction force. The proposed controller formulates the thruster-assisted spring-loaded inverted pendulum dynamics as a condensed QP-based model predictive control problem, enabling simultaneous regulation of ground contact force and active thrust vectoring at 500 Hz. A decoupled control architecture is used, where the robot's sagittal dynamics are controlled using QP-MPC while the frontal dynamics is regulated using a cascade orientation stabilization controller. Two experiments were conducted with different forward reference velocities of 0 m/s and 0.1 m/s. While the instantaneous velocity oscillates, the mean velocities can track their respective reference. Additionally, joint tracking error remains within 1 deg while tracking the desired leg length given by the leg trajectory controller and desired swing trajectory given by Raibert's heuristic. The QP-MPC problem is consistently solved with 0.18ms, which is well within the 2ms computation budget while satisfying the GRF friction cone constraint.
items.comment: To be published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)

items.title_en: Auditing Semantic and Relational Reliability in Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction Evaluation
items.title_zh: 开放词汇人-物交互评估中的语义与关系可靠性审计
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary human-object interaction detectors describe interactions in free text, and this creates a problem for evaluation. Category scoring rejects valid paraphrases, while semantic similarity scoring can reward predictions that name the wrong action or reverse the roles of the participants. We present a diagnostic protocol that holds every prediction fixed and scores it under five views, namely official category evaluation, an identity control, lexical normalization, graded semantic credit, and strict propositional equivalence. Comparing these views separates the effect of the matching engine from the effect of semantic credit. The protocol pairs controlled transformations that preserve or break meaning with a blinded audit of natural predictions, and we derive consistency checks that link mean credit, invalid acceptance, and transformation counts. Applied to six systems on HICO-DET, the views disagree on which system leads. GEN-VLKT leads under official evaluation, SL-HOI leads under SHOE, and GEN-VLKT leads again under strict equivalence. Semantic gains range from 1.6 to 20.3 mAP, and AgentHOI keeps less than half of its gain once equivalence is enforced. We recommend that semantic scores be reported together with relational validity and paired uncertainty, so that recovered credit is not read as better interaction understanding.

items.title_en: Validation of Human Motor Development Scales with Humanoid Robots
items.title_zh: 用人形机器人验证人类运动发育量表
items.abstract_en: We investigate how humanoid robots can learn a series of motor skills defined by human infant motor development scales, and we evaluate which scales are comprehensive enough to serve as self-contained guides for developing gross motor skills up to standing and walking. We represent each motor development scale as a developmental graph that guides the training of a humanoid robot. We then apply this graph within a reinforcement learning framework so that the robot learns skills following the natural phases of human motor development described by the scale. Our work demonstrates that graphs derived from three out of four popular pediatric motor scales can successfully guide humanoid robots to develop these skills. The fourth scale misses some intermediate milestones that the other scales have, which causes some failures. After adding a missing milestone in its graph, it also enables the robot to develop those skills successfully.
items.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to ICRA 2027. Video available at https://youtu.be/SR3LUVhohV4

rm.usage: 用发育图+强化学习分阶段训练运动技能，思路可迁移到仿真环境中为哨兵/英雄设计分阶段课程学习（先原地转向、再定点移动、再避障对抗）；但对象是人形站立行走，与轮式底盘差异大，直接价值有限。

items.title_en: Energy-Score Stabilized Attentive Mixture-Density Policy: A Lightweight Approach to Multimodal Robot Motion
items.title_zh: 能量分数稳定的注意力混合密度策略：一种多模态机器人运动的轻量级方法
items.abstract_en: For practical motion generation, it is essential to handle multimodality (multiple actions can be correct for the same observation) while maintaining low inference cost and strong generalization from limited demonstrations. We introduce an attentive mixture-density policy trained with the Energy Score that represents future visuomotor trajectories as explicit probability distributions with a single forward pass. Concretely, we output Gaussian mixture parameters for joint commands (and optionally attention points) and optimize them with the Energy Score (computed as a sum of 1D CRPS under a diagonal covariance assumption) instead of the negative log-likelihood (NLL) to avoid MDN singularities and gradient-scale instabilities. Our architecture couples explicit spatial attention with mixture-density outputs, enabling robust multimodal behavior selection under visual noise and small-data regimes. On an 8-DOF manipulator, the method generates distinct avoidance trajectories and stabilizes learning in obstacle avoidance. Moreover, in a randomized moving-object grasping task, where spatiotemporal multimodality and fast timing decisions are required, the proposed model outperforms Diffusion Policy by 15-25% under several unseen conditions, demonstrating superior generalization and real-time feasibility.
items.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Accepted to IROS 2026

rm.usage: 其"注意力混合密度+Energy Score"可用来从人工操作/实战录像中学习哨兵导航决策，输出同一态势下多种可行走位的概率分布，避免单峰回归把多种正确走位平均成撞墙路线。

items.title_en: Scalable, Intuitive, Mixed Reality-Based Semi-Autonomous Robotic Telemanipulation for the Execution of a Fine-Grained Bimanual Task
items.title_zh: 面向细粒度双手任务执行的可扩展、直观、基于混合现实的半自主机器人遥操作
items.abstract_en: Nowadays, robotic telemanipulation enables humans to control robots so as to execute tasks in a manner similar to how they perform them, and serves as an essential approach for collecting on-robot data for robot learning by human demonstrations. The quality of collected demonstrations directly impacts the performance of the learned policy. However, existing telemanipulation systems rely heavily on human operation, particularly for large-scale data collection. Collecting dozens or hundreds of demonstrations is a demanding process, as operators tend to fatigue quickly, especially during the execution of dexterous tasks that require sustained concentration. Recently, semi-autonomous robotic telemanipulation has emerged as a promising direction that reduces operator workload while preserving human-in-the-loop control for task execution. We therefore introduce a scalable, intuitive, semi-autonomous robotic telemanipulation system that leverages a mixed reality (MR) headset for on-robot data collection. The system autonomously executes the majority of the task trajectories and only requires the operator to make fine adjustments at key stages. We validate the effectiveness of our system by collecting data and training imitation learning policies on the execution of a high-precision, fine-grained bimanual peg-in-hole task. With lower data collection effort, our system obtains high-quality demonstrations that can be used to train fully autonomous task execution policies.
items.comment: 8 pages, 9 figures. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026

items.title_en: Goal Images Are Control Targets: Spatially-Grounded Goal-Image Synthesis for Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: 目标图像即控制目标：面向机器人操作的空间锚定目标图像合成
items.abstract_en: Goal-conditioned manipulation policies are steered by a goal image, a picture of the desired post-manipulation scene synthesized from the current observation and a language instruction. The prevailing assumption is that better image-editing quality yields better goals, so goal generators are built and compared using general image-editing metrics. We show this assumption is false. Across two independent goal-conditioned policies on CALVIN, the image editors that top aggregate editing-quality leaderboards (Gemini 3 Pro Image and GPT Image 1.5) produce worse control targets than our proposed far smaller finetuned open models, and the gap widens sharply for the multi-step (long-horizon) tasks robots actually face. A per-dimension analysis explains why. Downstream policy success is governed almost entirely by manipulation adherence (selecting the right object and the right final state; Spearman $ρ\approx 0.9$ with success), while photorealism and aesthetic fidelity, precisely where large proprietary editors excel, are uncorrelated with success ($ρ\approx 0$). This dissociation holds on both CALVIN and the real-world-aligned SIMPLER-Bridge benchmark. We then present SGE-Goal, a spatially-grounded decomposed editing framework that predicts initial and final 2D edit-region masks before goal-image synthesis. SGE-Goal turns open base models (FLUX.1 Kontext, FLUX.2 klein) into the strongest goal generators we evaluate on CALVIN, and second only to Gemini 3 Pro Image on SIMPLER-Bridge. Base models fine-tuned with SGE-Goal also hold up under chaining far better than the best proprietary editor, sustaining roughly seven times the success rate at the longest (five-step) chains. We release code, datasets, checkpoints, and a human-aligned diagnostic evaluator. Our results argue that goal generators must be selected by downstream utility, not by editing-quality leaderboards.

items.title_en: CondenseVLA: Learnable History Condensation for Efficient Multi-Frame VLA
items.title_zh: CondenseVLA：面向高效多帧VLA的可学习历史压缩
items.abstract_en: Robot manipulation often depends on short-term cues - such as brief contacts, temporary occlusions, and intermediate object states - that are ambiguous in a single frame and can only be resolved by integrating observations over time. However, injecting historical information solely by enlarging the history window is computationally costly and frequently yields limited gains due to substantial redundancy and task-agnostic, inflexible sampling of observations. We propose CondenseVLA, a multi-frame VLA policy with a learnable decoder-side history condensation module for using short-term visual context in action decoding. Given a sequence of cached per-frame features from the VLM backbone, CondenseVLA distills observation history into a fixed set of slot tokens using learnable queries and multi-head cross-attention. Simple auxiliary regularization penalizes overlap among slot attention maps and decorrelates slot embeddings, encouraging complementary attention and reducing slot redundancy. Across the evaluated tasks, CondenseVLA improves Simpler-WidowX success from 58.7% to 69.8% (+11.1 percentage points), achieves 97.2% on LIBERO, and reaches 52.8% on real-world tasks. It achieves 21.6% success on memory-dependent RMBench tasks. These results support selective condensation of bounded recent visual evidence for action decoding, while harder multi-observation tasks expose the limits of a finite history window. Project page: https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA
items.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 39 pages, including supplementary material and the NeurIPS paper checklist. Project page: https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA

items.title_en: CODA: Cohort- and Drift-aware Foundation Model for Multimodal Clinical Reasoning
items.title_zh: CODA：面向多模态临床推理的队列与漂移感知基础模型
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse clinical tasks. However, existing approaches predominantly operate at the individual sample level and fail to model the interplay between population-level cohort patterns and patient-specific variation that underlie real-world clinical reasoning. In practice, clinicians routinely reason through patient cohorts sharing similar demographic, physiological, or pathological characteristics, while accounting for patient-specific deviations from the group prototype. Motivated by this gap, we propose CODA, a cohort- and drift-aware foundation model for multimodal clinical reasoning. CODA explicitly integrates cohort structure into the modeling pipeline through two complementary mechanisms: cohort-aware population stratification and drift-aware individual adaptation. In particular, we leverage reinforcement learning to discover clinically meaningful patient cohorts, and further model each patient's deviation from cohort prototypes as a structured drift signal encoding fine-grained individual heterogeneity. These cohort- and drift-aware representations are incorporated into the foundation model to enable reasoning that is simultaneously informed by population-level patterns and sensitive to individual-level variation. Extensive experiments on real-world electronic health record (EHR) benchmarks demonstrate that CODA achieves consistent effectiveness and strong generalizability across diverse clinical tasks, including closed-QA, open-QA, and report generation.

items.title_en: Vision-Language-Delta-Action: Learning Compact Deltas as Actionable Transition Interfaces for Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: Vision-Language-Delta-Action：学习紧凑增量作为机器人操作的可操作过渡接口
items.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation is not merely observation-to-action generation, but the realization of task-specified state changes in the physical world. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) methods directly learn observation-to-action mappings, imposing a substantial learning burden due to the gap between semantic understanding and action execution. Although world-action models (WAMs) improve control through future prediction, modeling complete future states wastes capacity on static appearance and action-irrelevant changes. We propose Vision-Language-Delta-Action (VLDA), a paradigm that reformulates full future prediction as compact actionable transition modeling. Its core is a compact Delta variable that captures latent world-state changes, serving as an interface between vision-language understanding and action generation. VLDA learns Delta through a unified objective composed of the Local Transition Filter (LT-Filter) and Global Transition Anchor (GT-Anchor). LT-Filter captures task-relevant manipulation-centric changes while suppressing static reconstruction biases. GT-Anchor provides coarse future-level regularization to preserve the overall direction of state changes. Delta-Driven Action Refinement (DDAR) further grounds Delta in the action manifold and injects it as a structured seed to guide action denoising. We implement VLDA within LoongForge, an open-source training framework for large-scale foundation and embodied models, using its modular and distributed infrastructure for unified two-stage optimization. Experiments show that VLDA improves long-horizon consistency, robustness, and generalization, validating actionable Delta as an alternative to direct action prediction and full future-state modeling.

items.title_en: BodyBridge: Grounded Body Layers for Sim-to-Real Translation of Vulnerable Road Users
items.title_zh: BodyBridge：面向弱势道路使用者仿真到现实迁移的接地身体层
items.abstract_en: Simulation-to-real driving video diffusion models can translate photorealistic scenes, but they typically represent pedestrians and cyclists, vulnerable road users (VRUs), as generic object classes. This is insufficient for vulnerable road users whose safety-relevant appearance depends on articulated pose and identity. We present BodyBridge and Grounded Body Layers (GBL), a simulator-derived, pixel-aligned representation that combines scene geometry, canonical per-pixel body correspondence, and exact VRU masks. GBL provides explicit articulation to the video diffusion model, emphasizes VRU regions during control-branch post-training, and supports additive composition with scene-geometry control at inference. It also enables per-joint evaluation of generated VRUs and a failure taxonomy for identity errors. On CARLA-to-real translation, BodyBridge improves near-range PCK@0.5 by 22% over the released depth-conditioned baseline. Replacing normal-map body control with canonical correspondence reduces body flips by 18%, while composition reduces near-range facing flips by 27%. These results show that explicit body grounding complements scene-level control and improves pose-faithful VRU generation. All code, data, and model checkpoints will be made publicly available to support reproducible, pedestrian-aware autonomous driving research.

items.title_en: Towards Reinforcement Learning for Space Robotics: Fast Training and Reliable Real-World Transfer
items.title_zh: 面向空间机器人的强化学习：快速训练与可靠的现实世界迁移
items.abstract_en: This work demonstrates the use of a fast simulation-based training framework to learn control policies using reinforcement learning. The hardware requirements are minimal and the simulation-learned policies transfer reliably to the real world. With this setup, we show that a quadruped robot can learn to traverse diverse real-world terrains reliably---including in a lunar-analog facility---after less than 20 minutes of training on a single consumer-grade GPU. These results provide a glimpse of a future where reinforcement learning is a crucial tool in developing more capable and robust space robotic systems. Video demonstrations are available at https://youtu.be/vUFJiZdJaQ0.
items.comment: Presented at the Space Robotics Workshop at IROS 2026

items.title_en: Simultaneous Force and Motion Control in Generalised Coordinates
items.title_zh: 广义坐标下的力与运动同时控制
items.abstract_en: Robot manipulators often come into contact with rigid objects when performing work. This imposes physical constraints on their motion. Simultaneous force & motion control was developed to regulate contact forces commensurate with these constraints, whilst projecting motion control in to the orthogonal, unconstrained directions. This is typically formulated in the task coordinates, i.e. operational space, then mapped to joint torques to command the robot. However, most constraints on the robot control, such as joint limits, collision avoidance, singularity avoidance, etc. are naturally expressed in generalised coordinates (joint space). Thus, formulating the control problem in task space makes it difficult to guarantee control feasibility. In this paper Gauss' principle of least constraint is used to solve the control as a quadratic programming (QP) problem in generalised coordinates. It is shown that the theoretical solution to this problem produces the correct constrained dynamics for accurate contact force control. Moreover, inequality constraints may be appended to ensure feasibility and safety. Simulation results were conducted in MuJoCo and compared to the operational space formulation. The proposed method is able to simultaneously maintain a desired contact force, minimise trajectory tracking error, and adhere to practical inequality constraints.
items.abstract_zh: 机械臂作业时常接触刚性物体，运动因此受到物理约束。力与运动同时控制正是为在约束方向上调节接触力、并将运动控制投影到正交的无约束方向而提出，通常在任务坐标（操作空间）中建模再映射为关节力矩。然而关节限位、避碰、奇异回避等控制约束天然定义在广义坐标（关节空间）中，任务空间建模难以保证控制可行性。本文利用高斯最小约束原理，把控制问题写成广义坐标下的二次规划（QP）。理论分析表明，其解可给出正确的约束动力学，实现精确接触力控制；同时可附加不等式约束以保证可行性与安全性。在 MuJoCo 仿真中与操作空间法对比，所提方法能同时维持期望接触力、最小化轨迹跟踪误差，并满足实际不等式约束。
items.highlight_zh: 用高斯最小约束原理在关节空间把力/运动控制解成 QP，兼顾可行性
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：机械臂接触刚性物体时，既要控制接触力又要控制运动。经典做法是在任务空间（操作空间）中求解，再映射成关节力矩。但关节限位、避碰、奇异回避这些真正的限制条件都天然写在关节空间里，因此在任务空间中求解很难保证控制可行，可能解出违反约束的指令。
方法：作者改用高斯最小约束原理（Gauss' principle of least constraint），把力与运动同时控制直接建模为广义坐标（关节空间）下的二次规划（QP）问题；不等式约束（如关节限位）可以直接加入 QP，以保证可行性与安全性。
结果：理论分析表明，该 QP 的解能给出正确的约束动力学，从而精确控制接触力；在 MuJoCo 仿真中与操作空间法对比，所提方法能同时维持期望接触力、最小化轨迹跟踪误差，并满足实际不等式约束。
为何重要：把约束放回其本来的坐标，使高层任务目标与底层安全、可行性约束在同一优化中统一处理。对需要频繁接触作业的机械臂（装配、打磨、抓取）有直接的工程价值，也为后续加入更多硬约束留出了统一接口。
items.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027

rm.usage: 把力/运动同时控制写成广义坐标下的 QP，可附加关节限位、避碰、奇异回避等不等式约束。工程机器人装配（安装 42mm 发射机构、能量单元）正需要带接触力调节与安全约束的机械臂控制，可把该 QP 框架直接用于工程臂的装配对接环节。

items.title_en: Pedicel-Targeted Strawberry Harvesting via Imitation Learning on a Low-Cost Teleoperated Robotic Arm
items.title_zh: 基于模仿学习的低成本遥操作机械臂花梗靶向草莓采摘
items.abstract_en: Precise pedicel-targeted grasping in strawberry harvesting remains a critical bottleneck due to the pedicel's small diameter (1.3-3 mm), color similarity with surrounding foliage, and precise force control required for clean abscission zone detachment. As a market-grade crop, strawberry aesthetic value makes bruise-free pedicel detachment essential over direct fruit grasping. Classical approaches struggle to unify vision models, motion planning, and contact manipulation into a robust framework, particularly in occluded canopy environments. Therefore, this work presents a visuomotor imitation learning pipeline for pedicel-targeted strawberry harvesting that unifies perception, motion planning, and contact manipulation from collecting human teleoperation demonstrations, training an Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) policy with a ResNet-50 visual backbone, and deploying the learned policy autonomously on a Jetson AGX Orin edge platform at 15 Hz. The trained policy achieved consistent loss convergence from 2.84 to 0.091 over 100K gradient steps on 130 demonstrations. We have also established a reproducible open-source pipeline with publicly released dataset and model weights for the agricultural robotics community. Full dataset is available at, https://huggingface.co/datasets/nitindominicrai/strawberry_pedicel_grasp_teleoperation and trained policy at, https://huggingface.co/nitindominicrai/act_strawberry_pedicel. To replicate this work, all code, configurations, and deployment instructions are publicly available at, https://github.com/nitin-dominic/autonomous_strawberry_pedicel_harvesting.
items.abstract_zh: 草莓采摘中花梗直径仅 1.3–3 mm、与周围枝叶颜色相近，且需精确力控才能干净切断离层，使花梗靶向抓取成为关键瓶颈；作为商品性作物，无损伤的花梗分离比直接抓取果实更重要。传统方法难以把视觉模型、运动规划与接触操作统一为鲁棒框架，在遮挡冠层中尤为困难。为此，本文提出视觉运动模仿学习流程：采集人类遥操作示范，训练以 ResNet-50 为视觉骨干的 ACT（Action Chunking with Transformers）策略，并在 Jetson AGX Orin 边缘平台以 15 Hz 自主部署。130 条示范、10 万梯度步内损失由 2.84 收敛至 0.091。数据集、模型权重与代码均已公开，形成可复现的开源流程。
items.highlight_zh: 用 ACT 模仿学习让低成本机械臂在边缘端 15 Hz 自主采草莓花梗
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：草莓若直接抓果实容易压伤、影响商品价值，因此应抓住直径仅 1.3–3 mm 的花梗，并在离层处干净分离。但花梗极细、颜色与枝叶相近、常被遮挡，还需精确控力，传统“视觉模型＋运动规划＋接触控制”的分模块方案在遮挡冠层中很难稳定整合。
方法：作者采用端到端模仿学习。先用低成本遥操作机械臂采集 130 条人类示范，训练 ACT（Action Chunking with Transformers）策略，视觉骨干为 ResNet-50；再把学到的策略部署到 Jetson AGX Orin 边缘平台，以 15 Hz 自主运行。
结果：训练在 10 万梯度步内使损失由 2.84 稳定降到 0.091，说明策略能较好地拟合示范。作者同时完整开源了数据集、模型权重、代码与部署说明，形成可复现的流程。
为何重要：一是把感知、规划与接触操作统一进一个可学习策略，绕开了模块化管线在细小目标上难以对接的问题；二是验证了低成本硬件加边缘算力即可跑通精细农业操作；三是开源降低了农业机器人社区复现与横向比较的门槛。需要说明的是，文中主要报告训练收敛与部署流程，尚未给出大规模田间采摘成功率的统计。
items.comment: 4 pages, 3 figures. This paper was peer-reviewed and accepted in the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), "From Innovation to Adoption: Hardware, AI, Policy, and Funding Challenges in Agricultural Robotics Workshop," Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, 2026

rm.usage: 提供了一条「遥操作采集示范 → ACT 视觉运动策略 → Jetson 边缘 15Hz 部署」的完整开源流程。工程机器人视觉装配可借鉴这套模仿学习流水线，用少量人工示范快速教会机械臂抓取和对接模块，降低手工编程成本。

items.title_en: CLARO: Clutter Aware Robot Orchestrator for Open-Vocabulary Grasping using VLM Agents
items.title_zh: CLARO：面向开放词汇抓取、使用VLM智能体的杂乱感知机器人编排器
items.abstract_en: Robots that follow natural-language instructions unlock a wide range of autonomous applications in households, warehouses, and labs. Real-world environments are diverse and often heavily cluttered, requiring robots to plan over multiple steps, act, and replan as they work toward a goal. We present CLARO (CLutter-Aware Robot Orchestrator), a VLM agent that orchestrates a set of perception and manipulation skills: open-vocabulary object detection, segmentation, 6-DoF grasping, and non-prehensile pushing to locate and retrieve a language-specified target in clutter. CLARO maintains a memory of its past actions to support long-horizon execution, and emits manipulation targets (grasp poses/3D waypoints) allowing transfer across robot arms without task-specific training. We evaluate CLARO against a range of methods on a dynamic simulation environment and standard image-based benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization across object classes, lighting, and clutter levels. CLARO attains an average success rate of 89.1%, a relative improvement of over 16% on the strongest competing method in high cluttered scenes. We further analyze performance along grounding and grasping axes to characterize where each method succeeds and fails. Finally, we deploy CLARO on a robot arm across diverse cluttered scenes, achieving a success rate of 88.8%, and demonstrating strong sim2real generalizability.

rm.usage: VLM智能体「检测-分割-6DoF抓取-推挤-重规划」的分层技能编排框架，可参考用于工程机器人视觉装配：先定位目标模块与障碍，再分步抓取、推挤到位并失败重规划；但需换成RM专属感知与机械臂接口。

items.title_en: FastVLA: Task-Conditioned and Temporally Adaptive Visual Token Compression for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
items.title_zh: FastVLA：面向高效视觉-语言-动作模型的任务条件化与时间自适应视觉 Token 压缩
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models present a promising paradigm for general-purpose robot manipulation, but closed-loop deployment is often limited by inference efficiency: at each timestep, high-resolution, often multi-view images are encoded into hundreds of visual tokens that dominate transformer computation and latency. Token compression via attention is a natural solution but is challenging for VLA control because (1) decision-critical tokens are determined by the task, not generic visual saliency, and (2) the token budget varies substantially across steps, so static metrics and budgets waste computation or discard control-critical tokens. We introduce FastVLA, a training-free, task-aware, and temporally adaptive visual token compression framework. At each step, FastVLA scores token importance via task-to-vision attention and adaptively sets the compression rate from the importance-distribution uniformity, measured by an inverse-Simpson metric with online sliding-window calibration. We evaluate FastVLA on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, and CogACT across LIBERO and SIMPLER, and on a physical Franka Research 3 robot. In simulation, it reduces LLM-backbone FLOPs by 35-59\% and action latency by 9-32\% (a 1.09$\times$-1.46$\times$ speedup) while maintaining task success, achieving a comparable or better efficiency-performance trade-off than existing plug-and-play token compression/pruning/reuse baselines. On the real robot, it cuts end-to-end latency by 20\% (1.25$\times$ speedup) at comparable success. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/FastVLA.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型是通用机器人操作的有力范式，但闭环部署常受推理效率限制：每个时间步都要把高分辨率、多视角图像编码成数百个视觉 token，主导了 Transformer 计算与延迟。基于注意力的 token 压缩对 VLA 控制并不简单：决策关键 token 由任务而非通用视觉显著性决定；且 token 预算随步数大幅波动，静态指标与固定预算会浪费算力或丢弃控制关键 token。本文提出 FastVLA——免训练、任务感知、时间自适应的视觉 token 压缩框架：每步用任务到视觉的注意力给 token 打分，并以逆 Simpson 指标衡量重要性分布均匀度、结合在线滑窗校准自适应设定压缩率。在 OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、CogACT 与 LIBERO、SIMPLER 及真实 Franka Research 3 上验证：仿真中 LLM 主干 FLOPs 降低 35–59%、动作延迟降低 9–32%（1.09–1.46 倍加速）且成功率保持；真机端到端延迟降低 20%（1.25 倍加速）。
items.highlight_zh: 免训练、随任务自适应的视觉 token 压缩，真机延迟降 20%
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型是通用机器人操作的有力范式，但闭环部署受推理速度拖累：每个控制步都要把高分辨率、多视角图像编码成数百个视觉 token，这些 token 主导了 Transformer 的计算量与延迟。
难点：直接照搬视觉领域的 token 压缩行不通。①哪些 token 对决策关键取决于当前任务指令，而不是通用视觉显著性——背景里高对比的物体未必有用；②不同时刻所需的 token 数量差别很大，固定的压缩率或静态重要性指标要么浪费算力，要么丢掉控制关键信息。
方法：FastVLA 是免训练框架，无需重训 VLA。每一步用“任务到视觉”的注意力给 token 打分，再用逆 Simpson 指标衡量重要性分布的均匀程度，据此自适应决定压缩率，并用在线滑动窗口做校准。
结果：在 OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、CogACT 三种模型，LIBERO、SIMPLER 两个仿真基准以及真实 Franka Research 3 机械臂上评测：仿真中 LLM 主干 FLOPs 降低 35–59%，动作延迟降低 9–32%（1.09–1.46 倍加速），成功率保持；真机端到端延迟降低 20%（1.25 倍加速），成功率相当。与现有即插即用的 token 压缩、剪枝、复用基线相比，效率-性能折中相当或更优。
为何重要：它让“看得更全、算得更少”在 VLA 闭环控制中成为现实，且即插即用，便于直接接入已有系统。

rm.usage: 针对 VLA 模型的视觉 token 压缩与推理加速，RoboMaster 目前几乎不使用 VLA 做控制，自瞄/导航也没有大模型主干，关联很弱；仅在探索「大模型直接输出云台/底盘指令」时才有间接参考价值。

items.title_en: Onboard Lightweight LLM Reasoning for Human-Aware Safe UAV Navigation
items.title_zh: 面向人机共融安全无人机导航的机载轻量化 LLM 推理
items.abstract_en: Aerial robots operating near people must treat a pedestrian, a parked car, and a wall differently, yet conventional perception--planning stacks reduce all of them to occupied geometry---a \emph{human-aware safety gap} in which category-specific clearance is unavailable to the planner and temporary occlusions remove pedestrian-specific constraints from its map. We present a modular, fully onboard pipeline that closes this gap by turning visual observations into context-dependent safety constraints for real-time UAV navigation. A shared BLIP encoder drives scene captioning and text-conditioned segmentation, which is fused with depth to localize obstacles in 3D. Obstacle-specific risk is inferred by a lightweight LLM (Qwen-2.5-0.5B) stabilized with retrieval-augmented generation and grammar-constrained decoding that restricts its output to a planner-compatible JSON schema. The LLM reasons once per object category rather than per frame: its verdicts are cached per class, so previously seen categories are resolved without inference and new ones trigger a fresh retrieval-grounded query; detections are additionally given persistent identities and held in the map across occlusions. The perception pipeline runs at 10\,Hz on a Jetson Orin NX, while fallback LLM queries take approximately 0.8\,s and remain off the control-critical path. In Gazebo, low-altitude urban navigation among pedestrians and vehicles shows a roughly $3\times$ reduction in collision events over a geometric planner, and semantics-aware landing among moving actors raises success from 34\% to 96\%. The 224-pixel encoder input limits reliable small-object perception at range; conservative pedestrian margins and short-term persistence mitigate this limitation during navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 在人群附近作业的无人机需要区别对待行人、停放车辆与墙壁，但传统感知—规划流水线把它们一律简化为占据几何，形成“人类感知安全鸿沟”：规划器拿不到与类别相关的安全间距，临时遮挡还会让行人的专属约束从地图中消失。本文提出一条模块化、完全机载的流水线：共享 BLIP 编码器驱动场景描述与文本条件分割，再与深度图融合实现障碍物三维定位；障碍物风险由轻量级 LLM（Qwen-2.5-0.5B）推断，并用检索增强生成与语法约束解码稳定输出，使其只产生规划器兼容的 JSON。LLM 按物体类别而非逐帧推理，结果按类缓存，检测目标具有持久身份以跨越遮挡。在 Gazebo 城市低空导航中，碰撞事件较几何规划器减少约 3 倍，语义感知着陆成功率由 34% 提升至 96%。编码器 224 像素输入限制了远距离小目标感知。
items.highlight_zh: 类别级缓存 LLM 语义约束，碰撞事件减少约 3 倍
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究了什么问题：无人机在人群附近飞行时，必须对行人、汽车、墙给出不同的安全间距，但常规方法把所有障碍都当成“占地方的一块几何”，规划器无法按类别设定安全边界；而且行人被临时遮挡后，其专属约束还会从地图上消失。
2) 用了什么方法：作者搭建一条完全运行在机载设备上的模块化流水线。用共享的 BLIP 编码器同时完成场景描述和“文本条件分割”，再与深度图融合，把障碍物定位到三维空间。风险判断交给轻量级 LLM（Qwen-2.5-0.5B），并用检索增强生成（RAG）加语法约束解码，强制输出规划器能直接读取的 JSON 格式。关键效率设计是“按类别推理”，不按帧推理：同一类物体只询问一次 LLM，结果缓存复用；新类别才触发新的检索查询。检测到的物体还获得持久身份，被遮挡时仍保留在地图中。
3) 有什么结果：整套感知在 Jetson Orin NX 上以 10 Hz 运行，LLM 兜底查询约 0.8 秒，且不在控制关键路径上，因此不会拖慢实时控制。Gazebo 中行人车辆混行的城市低空场景里，碰撞事件比纯几何规划器减少约 3 倍；在移动目标间进行语义感知着陆，成功率从 34% 提升到 96%。
4) 为何重要：它把“物体是什么、该离多远”这类语义安全约束变成了机载实时可用的东西，而不是依赖云端大模型。作者也如实说明局限：224 像素输入在远距离小目标上不可靠，只能靠保守的行人安全裕度和短时记忆来缓解。

rm.usage: 其核心是用轻量 LLM 输出受语法约束的规划器兼容 JSON，并做按类缓存与目标持久身份跟踪。哨兵导航场景较为结构化（无行人语义需求），可直接借鉴的是「LLM 输出结构化决策指令+目标 ID 跨遮挡维持」这一思路，可用于哨兵战术层决策或雷达多目标 ID 保持。

items.title_en: From Views to Worlds: Active Exploration over 3D Worlds for Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 从视图到世界：面向视觉语言模型的3D世界主动探索
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in 2D visual understanding tasks, yet the passive view-centric perception paradigm limits their capacity for 3D spatial reasoning. Such reasoning often requires actively acquiring spatial evidence beyond the currently visible views, such as camera poses and cross-view spatial relationships, to infer 3D relationships that are not explicitly represented in 2D images. However, existing methods either lack active exploration or merely provide additional views during inference, without explicitly acquiring such spatial evidence beyond 2D images. In this paper, we propose View-to-World (V2W), an active exploration framework that enables VLMs to actively explore 3D worlds and lifts VLMs from passive view-centric perception to active world-centric spatial reasoning. Given a spatial reasoning task with multi-view images, V2W first reconstructs an explicit 3D world with geometry, camera poses, and language-grounded semantics, and exposes it to VLMs through visual and linguistic interfaces. Through multi-turn interaction with these interfaces, VLMs iteratively acquire spatial evidence from the constructed 3D world, enabling active world-centric spatial reasoning. V2W can be integrated with existing VLMs in a training-free manner and can be further enhanced by optimizing the exploration policy via reinforcement learning. Experiments on spatial mental modeling benchmarks demonstrate that V2W substantially improves VLM baselines in the training-free setting and achieves state-of-the-art performance with the learned exploration policy, highlighting the importance of active exploration for spatial intelligence. Project page: \url{https://fangzhou2000.github.io/projects/v2w}.

rm.usage: 主动视角探索以补足3D空间关系的思路，可用于工程机器人机械臂装配时主动调整相机视角确认标签与能量单元位姿，或哨兵在遮挡下主动补看；但方法偏VLM通用推理，需大幅改造才落地。

items.title_en: SPEAR: Selective Preference Elicitation with Adaptive Rewards for VLM-Guided Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: SPEAR：面向 VLM 引导机器人操作的选择性偏好查询与自适应奖励
items.abstract_en: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable automated preference labeling for robotic manipulation, yet their deployment remains impractical since each query incurs substantial inference cost, while VLMs frequently abstain on visually challenging comparisons. We propose SPEAR, a framework that transforms VLMs into efficient preference oracles via two synergistic mechanisms. First, we design distinguishability-aware query selection to reduce abstention rates by targeting only informative and distinguishable comparisons. Second, we deploy an adaptive reward transition that bootstraps exploration with VLM-synthesized guidance before preference-based refinement. Experiments on the manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that SPEAR achieves 88.9% average success, outperforming baselines by 23.3 percentage points, while significantly reducing abstention and wall-clock training time on contact-rich tasks. SPEAR learns three Mobile ALOHA manipulation tasks fully online on real hardware, demonstrating end-to-end real-world applicability. By addressing query efficiency and exploration challenges, SPEAR establishes VLMs as practical preference oracles for scalable robot learning without manual reward engineering.
items.abstract_zh: 近期视觉语言模型（VLM）可为机器人操作自动标注偏好，但每次查询推理开销很大，且 VLM 在视觉上难以判断的比较中经常弃答，使其难以实际部署。我们提出 SPEAR 框架，通过两种协同机制将 VLM 变为高效的偏好预言机：其一，设计可区分性感知的查询选择，只针对有信息量且可区分的比较，从而降低弃答率；其二，引入自适应奖励过渡，先用 VLM 合成的引导信号启动探索，再以偏好数据做细化。在操作基准上的实验表明，SPEAR 平均成功率达 88.9%，比基线高出 23.3 个百分点，同时在接触丰富的任务中显著减少弃答并缩短训练实际耗时。SPEAR 在真实硬件上完全在线地学习了三个 Mobile ALOHA 操作任务，展示了端到端的实际可用性。通过解决查询效率与探索难题，SPEAR 让 VLM 成为可规模化机器人学习的实用偏好预言机，无需人工设计奖励。
items.highlight_zh: 平均成功率 88.9%，超基线 23.3 个百分点
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究了什么问题：用人类偏好来训练机器人技能很有效，但人工标注太贵。VLM 可以自动打偏好标签，却有两个问题：每次查询都要付出不小的推理成本；遇到视觉上难以分辨的两段操作时，VLM 常常给不出结论（弃答）。这让 VLM 当“偏好裁判”在工程上不划算。
2) 用了什么方法：SPEAR 用两个互补机制改造这一流程。第一是“可区分性感知的查询选择”：主动挑出既有信息量、VLM 又有把握分辨的比较，从源头压低弃答率，避免把预算浪费在模糊样本上。第二是“自适应奖励过渡”：训练初期先用 VLM 合成的引导信号帮助探索，等偏好数据积累后再切换到基于偏好的奖励细化，缓解纯偏好学习初期信号稀疏、探索困难的问题。
3) 有什么结果：在操作基准上平均成功率 88.9%，比基线高 23.3 个百分点；在接触丰富的任务中弃答率和训练实际耗时都明显下降。除仿真外，作者还在真实硬件上全在线学习了三个 Mobile ALOHA 操作任务，验证了端到端可行性。
4) 为何重要：它把“用 VLM 自动给奖励”从概念验证推进到能省查询、能稳定探索的实用方案，减少人工奖励工程，为可规模化的机器人学习提供了一条现实路径。
items.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at IROS 2026. Project page: https://zevinwu.github.io/spear-project

rm.usage: 用 VLM 自动生成偏好奖励、减少无效查询以加速强化学习训练。可迁移到仿真任务中，为自瞄命中、哨兵走位、多机协同等难以手工设计奖励的行为自动构造奖励函数，属于 RL 训练的支撑性工具。

items.title_en: MR-MPCC: Model Predictive Contouring Control for Robotic Manipulator Tracking under Moving Reference Frames
items.title_zh: MR-MPCC：移动参考坐标系下机器人机械臂跟踪的模型预测轮廓控制
items.abstract_en: Maintaining small path-tracking errors under moving reference frames is essential for robotic manipulation tasks with tight execution tolerances, such as machining and surgical automation. Conventional time-indexed controllers, including tracking Model Predictive Control (MPC), rely on a fixed temporal correspondence with the reference trajectory and may therefore accumulate path-relative error under abrupt reference-frame motion or timing mismatch. This paper presents MR-MPCC, a Model Predictive Contouring Control (MPCC) framework for velocity-controlled robotic manipulators with 6-DoF end-effector pose regulation under Moving-Reference disturbances. A hierarchical control architecture is adopted, in which an upper-level MPCC optimizes path progress while penalizing contouring and orientation errors, and a constrained resolved motion rate control (RMRC) layer maps the commanded Cartesian twist to feasible joint velocities under joint-level and safety constraints. MR-MPCC is implemented in a ROS2--MuJoCo pipeline and validated on a UR5e platform under moving-reference disturbances, where the path frame is perturbed and tracked by electromagnetic sensors. Compared with PI control and time-indexed tracking MPC under matched disturbance, MR-MPCC achieves lower geometric path-following error and smaller deviations in the moving path frame, demonstrating improved path-following performance under reference-frame motion.
items.comment: Accepted by The IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems 2026 (IROS 2026)

rm.usage: 针对移动参考系下路径跟踪误差累积问题的 MPCC 方法，可改造用于云台跟踪高速运动装甲板：以轮廓误差（垂直指向偏差）替代时间索引误差建模，减小目标机动与时延不匹配带来的跟踪滞后，配合弹道预测提升命中率。

items.title_en: OmniPoser: Flexible Human Motion Recovery in the Wild with Masked Flow Matching
items.title_zh: OmniPoser：基于掩码流匹配的野外灵活人体运动恢复
items.abstract_en: Recovering 3D human motion from sparse wearable sensors is challenging due to the inherent noise, occlusion, and instability of real-world tracking signals. Existing approaches are restricted to fixed sensor configurations and, when built on diffusion models, are computationally prohibitive for real-time deployment. We propose OmniPoser, a universal framework that recovers full-body SMPL motion from a flexible combination of heterogeneous inputs, such as 3D keypoints, sparse IMU rotations, head-mounted 6-DoF poses, or any subset thereof, within a single model. OmniPoser introduces a cross-modal masking mechanism paired with a Masked Conditioning Encoder, enabling one architecture to incorporate diverse sensor configurations through a masked design. A decoupled dual-stream generative backbone generates complete motion via Conditional Flow Matching, requiring only a single ODE integration step at inference. Across three settings and seven benchmarks, including in-the-wild Nymeria and Ego-Exo4D datasets, OmniPoser performs on par with state-of-the-art methods while running at over 700 FPS. The project page is available at https://jamesbridgewater51.github.io/omniposer-eccv/.
items.comment: Accepted as a poster at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026

items.title_en: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
items.title_zh: Ropedia W0：借助人类经验跨具身扩展移动操作世界模型
items.abstract_en: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, $Ψ_0$, $ω$-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.

rm.usage: 跨具身移动操作世界模型偏人形/移动操作数据驱动，与RM自瞄、导航、决策环节关联很弱，且训练成本高，暂不适合直接使用。

items.title_en: Physical Words: A Vocabulary for Structuring Latent Reasoning in Robot Manipulation
items.title_zh: Physical Words：用于结构化机器人操作中潜在推理的词汇表
items.abstract_en: Multimodal reasoning provides robotic foundation models with predictive context needed for reliable action generation. However, language-based reasoning captures task semantics but struggles to express fine-grained physical dynamics, while latent reasoning models future state evolution but offers limited structure for organizing these dynamics into reusable reasoning primitives. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysWord, a reasoning-before-acting foundation model built on Physical Words, which use atomic action verbs as shared semantic anchors for continuous representations of physical dynamics. Specifically, PhysWord predicts upcoming atomic action words and directly aligns their contextual hidden states with latent targets derived from the corresponding future observations. Building on these primitives, we construct a temporally structured PhysWord space with visual and optional tactile variants of each action word. Autoregressively predicting Physical Words across future timesteps captures transitions between execution stages, providing structured multimodal context for action generation. PhysWord achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 90.3\% on visuotactile UniVTAC and 99.6\% on vision-based LIBERO-Long, and outperforms competing methods on real-world tasks using bimanual grippers and dexterous hands. Further evaluations demonstrate that our structured latent reasoning framework generalizes to unseen scenarios and enables long-horizon manipulation.

rm.usage: 以原子动作动词做潜在推理的结构化表征，理论上可用于工程机器人装配动作序列的组织，但更偏通用操作基座模型，对RM具体任务帮助有限。

items.title_en: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
items.title_zh: CoopUQ：通过不确定性感知协同预测实现鲁棒多机器人社交导航
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning enables mobile robots to make fast and scalable navigation decisions in constrained human-shared environments. However, directly extending single-robot approaches to multi-robot settings often fails to ensure safety and efficiency, especially under occlusions and out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, where individual robots may overlook potential risks or make inaccurate predictions. Leveraging cooperation effectively for both prediction and navigation remains a major challenge. We propose CoopUQ, a multi-robot social navigation framework that bridges uncertainty-aware cooperative occupancy forecasting and robust decision making. CoopUQ predicts future occupancy grid maps through cross-robot spatiotemporal feature fusion and further leverages forecasts and their uncertainty to guide policy via constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning, where the cost penalizes navigation through regions predicted to be occupied or highly uncertain. This design enables the policy to adapt its risk sensitivity under distribution shifts. Experimental results across multiple Unity3D-based simulation environments with both in-distribution and OOD settings, including diverse layouts, pedestrian densities, and rushing behavior, demonstrate improved prediction performance and safety over representative baselines. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate its robustness across various scenes. Our code and videos are available at https://coopuq.github.io/.
items.comment: Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026); Project Website: https://coopuq.github.io/

rm.usage: 多机器人不确定性感知协同预测可借鉴到哨兵自主导航：把队友/对手位置的不确定度纳入预测与避让，在遮挡与分布外场景下保证安全高效；也与多机协同决策信息共享部分相关，但需去掉人类社会导航假设。

items.title_en: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
items.title_zh: 物理RSI能力从何而来？LLM-as-policy的观测缩放定律
items.abstract_en: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.

rm.usage: LLM作为策略在操作任务上的能力评测/缩放分析，与RM的竞技对抗类任务（自瞄、导航、决策）关联很弱，仅可作为大模型用于战术决策时的评估参考。

items.title_en: GPT-6 Astra Is a Native Visuo-Tactile Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra是面向接触丰富操作的原生视触觉策略
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal models have enabled GPT-6 Astra to perform robotic manipulation through in-context learning. Yet contact-rich control and tactile perception are often regarded as strengths of specialist policies, leaving open whether Astra can directly understand and use tactile observations. We provide, to our knowledge, the first demonstration that Astra directly interprets vision-based tactile images and uses their contact cues for manipulation. Tactile RGB images enter through its existing visual interface, enabling few-shot closed-loop control on nineteen simulated UniVTAC and OpenViTac tasks with 210 sampled scene seeds per setting. With visuo-tactile input, Astra achieves mean success rates of 93.8% and 81.8%, exceeding the strongest reported specialist baselines in our comparison by 22.9 and 13.1 percentage points, respectively. Vision-only performance also leads these baselines, reaching 76.3% and 80.6%. Trajectory analysis reveals active probing, cautious grasping, contact-guided alignment, and recovery, alongside difficulties with tangential loading and corrective execution. Our findings challenge the exclusivity of specialist policies in contact-rich manipulation and show that fine-grained vision can partially compensate for missing touch. They also identify vision-based tactile sensing as an interface for scaling contact understanding with foundation models and reveal signs of benchmark saturation. These results motivate joint visual-tactile pretraining, harder contact-rich evaluations, and physical-robot validation.
items.comment: 22 pages, 19 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://tactalent.github.io/

items.title_en: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Market Making on Prediction-Market Order Books
items.title_zh: 用于预测市场订单簿做市的合作多智能体强化学习
items.abstract_en: A market maker provides liquidity by quoting prices to buy and sell an asset, earning the spread while managing inventory risk. We study market makers trained with multi-agent reinforcement learning on prediction markets, specifically Polymarket, whose thin order books pose distinct challenges. Three challenges underpin this research: adverse selection may cause a policy trained on real data to stop quoting; the consequences of a quote can arrive many steps after the action; and prediction-market L2 data does not identify individual orders needed for simulation. We address these challenges by reconstructing order-level LOBSTER-format data from Polymarket and training agents in JaxMARL-HFT on 417 real markets. We enrich the baseline market maker's observation space with the book and recent flow, redesign its actions and inventory controls, and propose a cooperative multi-agent decomposition into a quoter and a risk manager trained using recurrent Independent Proximal Policy Optimisation (IPPO) with RNN policies. We investigate reward shaping, particularly reward blending and post-fill markout, to mitigate credit-assignment difficulties between the agents. Our redesigned single-agent market maker quotes more frequently and incurs smaller held-out losses than the retrained JaxMARL-HFT baseline, although the contributions of jointly changed observations, actions and risk constraints are not separately identified. Decomposition alone performs poorly; careful reward design substantially improves the desk relative to the unshaped split and yields our best result. Models are evaluated on realised end-of-episode portfolio value on held-out markets. None establishes positive average portfolio value in periodic held-out evaluation, and each configuration was trained with one seed. The environment, data and protocol lay a foundation for makers that quote many linked markets at once.
